channel.title: Governance Digest: aave
channel.description: New DAO governance proposals and discussions, summarized in plain English.

item.title: Syrup USDC (syrupUSDC) on Aave X Layer Assessments (aave)
item.description: A single thread collecting risk and technical assessments of syrupUSDC on Aave X Layer.

item.title: Risk Stewards: IRM Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.11.26 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising the base borrow-rate slope (Slope 1) by about 10-15 BPS on several stablecoin reserves across Aave V3 instances, plus changes to USDC on Arbitrum and mUSD on Monad.

item.title: [ARFC] Sentora Externally Curated Hub & Spoke Framework on Aave V4: Tempo OUSD Instance (aave)
item.description: An ARFC proposes a Sentora-curated Aave V4 Hub on the Tempo network where OUSD is the only borrowable asset, with BTC wrappers and PRIME as launch collateral.

item.title: [ARFC] Sentora Externally Curated Hub & Spoke on Aave V4: Base RLUSD Instance (aave)
item.description: An ARFC proposes a second Sentora-curated Aave V4 Hub on Base where RLUSD is the only borrowable asset, with cbBTC and cbXRP as launch collateral.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Add and Draw Cap Increases on Aave V4 / 2026.11.25 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising supply (add) and borrow (draw) caps on seven Aave V4 reserves, mainly USDC, USDT, WETH and WBTC on the Core Hub.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Cap and IRM Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.11.25 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends lower supply and borrow caps on several Aave V3 assets and interest rate model changes for USDC and USDT on V3 Core.

item.title: [Discussion] Aave × Supersmooth: sharing transaction based revenue with the DAO (aave)
item.description: Supersmooth.fi asks for feedback on becoming Aave's official partner for position management and sharing a portion of its transaction fees with the DAO.

item.title: OpenUSD (OUSD) on Aave Tempo Assessments (aave)
item.description: Low-information proposal: a thread that collects risk and technical assessments of OpenUSD (OUSD) on Aave Tempo.

item.title: [Research] Targeted Deleveraging of rsETH and osETH Through Exchange Rate Growth Discounting (aave)
item.description: A research post by TokenLogic suggests setting the CAPO growth cap to 0% on rsETH and osETH as a more targeted alternative to raising the WETH borrow rate.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Draw Cap Increases on Aave V4 / 2026.11.24 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising four draw caps on Aave V4 Ethereum Core Hub: WETH on two spokes, USDT and USDC.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Supply Cap Increases on Aave V3 / 2026.11.24 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising the JAAA supply cap on Aave V3 Horizon from 60M to 80M.

item.title: [ARFC] Collateral Factor Update for Coinbase Tokenized Equities on Base (aave)
item.description: An ARFC proposes lowering collateral factors for six of eight Coinbase tokenized equities on the Aave V4 Equities Hub on Base, citing higher stock volatility.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Add Cap Increases on Aave V4 / 2026.11.23 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising two Aave V4 add caps: cbBTC from 500 to 1,000 and cirBTC from 1,600 to 2,000.

item.title: [Discussion] Onboard cBTC (tacBTC) to Aave V3 Core and Aave V4 Core (aave)
item.description: A forum post asks whether Aave should onboard tacBTC, the ERC-20 form of the cBTC token, to the V3 Core instance, the V4 Core Hub, or both.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Supply Cap Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.11.23 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising the USDe supply cap on Aave V3 Core to 1.2B, cutting the sUSDe cap to 230M, and raising a cap on Aave V3 Arbitrum to 100M.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Borrow Cap Increases on Aave V3 / 2026.11.21 (aave)
item.description: A risk-service forum post recommends raising borrow caps for WETH, cbBTC and WBTC on Aave V3 Core.

item.title: [ARFC] - Enable LiquidityBufferController Sweeps via Circle Gateway on Aave V4 Ethereum Core Hub (aave)
item.description: A proposal would let Aave V4 move idle USDC from the Ethereum Core Hub into Circle Gateway to earn yield.

item.title: Coinbase Wrapped BTC (cbBTC) on Aave Tempo Assessments (aave)
item.description: Low-information post: a thread collecting risk assessments for cbBTC on Aave Tempo.

item.title: [Direct-To-AIP] Umbrella Reward Renewal and Parameter Update on Aave V3 Core (aave)
item.description: A direct-to-AIP proposal would extend Aave V3 Umbrella rewards to April 2, 2027 and raise stablecoin target liquidity.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Cap Changes on Aave V4 / 2026.11.20 (aave)
item.description: A risk-service forum post recommends raising several supply and borrow caps on Aave V4 and lowering the LBTC cap.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Supply and Borrow Cap and IRM Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.11.20 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising Aave V3 Core caps (USDC borrow to 4B, USDe, sUSDe, WBTC), cutting many caps across other instances, and setting rsETH-family supply caps to 1.

item.title: Aave V3.8 for integrators: what the reentrancy guard covers and what it leaves open (aave)
item.description: A technical forum post reviews Aave V3.8's new reentrancy lock: most Pool actions are now guarded, but flash loan callbacks stay open, as in V3.7.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Supply and Borrow Cap and IRM Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.11.19 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising several Aave V3 Core supply caps (USDC to 5B, WETH, wstETH, cbBTC, weETH) and cutting caps on Plasma, Mantle, Monad, Optimism, Polygon and Gnosis.

item.title: [ARFC] Expand Coinbase Tokenized Equities on Base (aave)
item.description: An ARFC proposes adding six Coinbase tokenized equities (Netflix, Oracle, Palantir, AMD, ServiceNow, Strategy) as collateral-only reserves on the Aave V4 Equities Hub on Base.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Cap and IRM Changes on Aave V4 / 2026.11.18 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends small Slope 1 rate increases on five Aave V4 stablecoin hub reserves and higher add caps for the NVDAc and METAc tokenized equities on the Base Equities Hub.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Cap and IRM Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.11.18 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends Aave V3 cap changes (WBTC supply cap up, USDT borrow cap up, USDC borrow cap down, two Horizon caps down) and a set of stablecoin interest-rate tweaks across several instances.

item.title: [Direct-to-AIP] Asset Listing - USDC Plasma (aave)
item.description: TokenLogic proposes listing Circle's native USDC on the Aave V3 Plasma instance, configured in line with USDT0, and adding it as a borrowable asset to eight eMode categories.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Supply and Borrow Cap Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.11.17 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends changing supply and borrow caps on Aave V3 Mantle, Monad, BNB and Core, mostly reductions, with increases for mUSD on Monad and BTCB on BNB.

item.title: [Risk Stewards] November 2026 - Stablecoin Interest Rate Adjustments (aave)
item.description: TokenLogic proposes interest-rate changes on 17 stablecoin reserves across Aave V3 and V4: higher Slope 1 on 16, lower on Base EURC, and Base USDC UOptimal from 90% to 92%.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Supply and Borrow Cap Increases on Aave V3 / 2026.11.15 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising supply or borrow caps on four Aave V3 reserves (wstETH, mUSD, AAVE, EURe) across Core, Monad, Arbitrum and Gnosis, to be applied through the Risk Steward process.

item.title: Aave Labs 180 Day Report (aave)
item.description: Aave Labs reports on its first 180 days as DAO service provider: about 97 team members, 6,096 tracked issues closed, 36 projects, and Aave V4 deposits growing to over 1.3 billion USD.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Supply and Borrow Cap Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.11.13 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends one cap increase (cbBTC) and several cuts on Aave V3 Core and Mantle, including USDT0 supply cap 312.5M to 150M.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Cap Increases on Aave V4 / 2026.11.13 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising eight supply and borrow caps on Aave V4 (Ethereum and Avalanche), including USDC add cap 75M to 85M and USDt add cap 110M to 150M.

item.title: Aave Labs. Request for Bounty Payout - November 2026 (aave)
item.description: Aave Labs asks for release of a 1,000 USD bounty for one valid bug bounty submission, plus a 100 USD Immunefi fee, 1,100 USD in total.

item.title: [Direct-to-AIP] November 2026 - Funding Update (aave)
item.description: TokenLogic posts the November funding update: acquire GHO to extend runway, consolidate cross-network assets onto Ethereum, deposit idle ETH, and fund a bug bounty and incentives.

item.title: [Direct-to-AIP] Ethena E-Mode Consolidation on Aave V3 (aave)
item.description: TokenLogic proposes common reference e-modes for Ethena collateral (USDe, sUSDe) on five Aave V3 markets and retiring legacy e-modes whose Pendle tokens have matured.

item.title: Technical Maintenance Proposals (aave)
item.description: Aave Labs opens a single thread for technical maintenance updates across Aave deployments from November 2026, such as oracle feed updates and permission cleanups.

item.title: Should Equities Hub carry a custodian-level exposure limit? Every reserve on it is custodied at Alpaca (aave)
item.description: A forum post asks whether the Aave V4 Base Equities hub should have a combined exposure limit per custodian, since all eight of its reserves are custodied at one broker-dealer.

item.title: [Direct-to-AIP] Reserve Factor Updates Across Aave V3 and V2 Markets (aave)
item.description: TokenLogic proposes raising Reserve Factors on 54 reserves across 12 Aave V3 instances and Aave V2 Ethereum, which the post says adds about $3.5M a year of DAO revenue and lifts the blended factor from 12.0% to 12.7%.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Borrow Cap Increases on Aave V3 / 2026.11.12 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising the USDC borrow cap on Aave V3 Core from 2.75B to 2.95B, after the reserve reached 99.0% of its current cap.

item.title: [ARFC] Dynamic Caps Oracle: Rate Limiter (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk proposes LlamaGuard Caps, a borrow rate limiter for Aave V3 that gives each reserve limited borrowing room which refills automatically, so large draws have to wait and the Protocol Guardian has time to react.

item.title: [ARFC] Repositioning Aave V3 Core Around Established & Liquid Collateral (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk proposes to freeze rsETH, osETH, LBTC, tBTC, rETH and some smaller reserves on Aave V3 Core, which together held $1.33B of collateral backing $1.03B of debt as of 9 November 2026.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Supply and Borrow Cap Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.11.10 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends 14 supply and borrow cap changes across Aave V3 markets, mostly reductions, with one increase for WBTC on Arbitrum.

item.title: Circle Wrapped Bitcoin (cirBTC) on Aave Ethereum Assessments (aave)
item.description: Low-information proposal

item.title: Risk Stewards: Supply and Borrow Cap Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.11.09 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends lowering most supply and borrow caps across Aave V3 instances, and raising one: the USD₮0 borrow cap on Arbitrum from 45M to 52.4M.

item.title: ACLManager: RISK_ADMIN_ROLE grants, Sep 2026 — decoded (aave)
item.description: A forum post decodes three RISK_ADMIN_ROLE grants on Aave V3 Ethereum since 2 September 2026, all sent by the governance Executor, and notes the role can change caps and risk parameters without a full vote.

item.title: Request: wallet list behind the Aave Insights treasury figure (aave)
item.description: An independent treasury analysis service asks TokenLogic for the wallet list and method behind the Aave Insights treasury figure ($260.65M at Q3 2026 close) so it can reconcile its own numbers.

item.title: Per-Asset Liquidation Thresholds Underpredict Co-Liquidation by 301× (aave)
item.description: A forum post reports a backtest finding that Aave V3 per-asset liquidation thresholds do not account for assets falling together, and argues for a joint probability model.

item.title: [TEMP CHECK] AAVE SECURITY SHIELD – Exploring Preventive Risk Controls for External Security Incidents (aave)
item.description: A community initiative (written in Spanish) proposes studying whether Aave could temporarily limit new debt during an external security incident while keeping repayments and liquidations working. It asks for a feasibility study, not protocol changes.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Supply and Borrow Cap Increases on Aave V3 / 2026.11.08 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising the USDC borrow cap on Aave V3 Core from 2.6B to 2.75B and the USDe supply cap from 550M to 750M, after both reserves reached near-full utilization.
